nodes.title: Pavel Holman
nodes.summary: Software engineer building typed, streaming web platforms.
nodes.body: Pavel Holman is a software engineer based in Prague. He works across the whole stack: typed backends built on Effect, SvelteKit frontends, and deployment on Cloudflare Workers. He prefers small, explicit systems with typed errors and evidence-backed claims, which is why this portfolio answers questions from a Knowledge Graph instead of a prose resume.

fields.lede: Software engineer who builds end-to-end web platforms with TypeScript and Effect, from the data model to the pixels.

nodes.title: Cloudflare Workers
nodes.summary: Edge deployment with Workers, static assets, Workers AI and Durable Objects.
nodes.body: Cloudflare Workers with static assets as the deployment target: wrangler-driven CI deploys, the Workers AI binding for embeddings and language models, rate limiting bindings and Durable Objects for per-day budgets.

nodes.title: Effect
nodes.summary: Effect for typed errors, dependency injection, streams and schemas.
nodes.body: Effect is used for everything on the server: typed errors instead of `throw`, services and layers for dependency injection, Streams for token-by-token responses, Schema for validation at every boundary, and Temporal plus the Clock service instead of `Date`.

nodes.title: Frontend
nodes.summary: Browser applications: layout, motion, accessibility, performance.
nodes.body: Frontend engineering as a practice: server-rendered HTML first, progressive enhancement, design tokens, motion that respects `prefers-reduced-motion`, and measured performance on real devices.

nodes.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
nodes.summary: GraphRAG-style retrieval over a hand-authored knowledge graph with cited answers.
nodes.body: Retrieval-augmented generation done GraphRAG-style: embed nodes and edges of a typed knowledge graph, seed by vector similarity, expand over weighted edges, budget the context, and make one streamed LLM call whose inline citations are validated server-side.

nodes.title: Svelte
nodes.summary: Svelte 5 runes and SvelteKit for server-rendered, interactive pages.
nodes.body: Svelte 5 with runes for fine-grained reactivity and SvelteKit for server-side rendering, streamed API routes and Cloudflare deployment.

nodes.title: Three.js
nodes.summary: WebGL scenes with Three.js and Threlte, shader-drawn points, on-demand rendering.
nodes.body: Three.js through Threlte inside Svelte: custom ShaderMaterial point clouds, additive line segments, camera controls, and an on-demand render loop that stays at 60 fps on phones.

nodes.title: TypeScript
nodes.summary: Strict TypeScript across backend, build tooling and the browser.
nodes.body: Strict TypeScript with `exactOptionalPropertyTypes` and `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, used for every layer of a project: schemas, build scripts, server code and UI. Types are treated as the primary documentation.

nodes.title: GraphRAG Portfolio
nodes.summary: This site. A 3D resume that answers questions from a knowledge graph and highlights its evidence.
nodes.body: An interactive 3D portfolio: a visitor asks a question or pastes a job description, retrieval selects a subgraph of the owner's professional history, one streamed LLM call answers with inline citations, and the 3D scene highlights the cited nodes as they arrive. Hand-authored Markdown nodes with typed frontmatter are validated and embedded at build time into a committed artifact; the runtime is a stateless Cloudflare Worker. Lint rules forbid `throw` and `Date` in favour of Effect and Temporal.

nodes.title: Independent software engineer
nodes.summary: Building web platforms and developer tooling under the Poqet name.
nodes.body: Independent work delivering web platforms and internal tooling: typed backends on Effect, SvelteKit frontends, and Cloudflare deployments with CI-driven releases and observability from day one.

nodes.title: Poqet
nodes.body: Poqet is the name under which Pavel Holman ships independent software work.

nodes.title: Developer Tooling
nodes.summary: Tools, platforms and libraries for other engineers.
nodes.body: Products whose users are software engineers: build tooling, internal platforms, libraries and documentation systems.
